translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Puhawang to Kod-imatoy ki Disas
Na, to nopongnga id nonaw ni Disas idda langun, id ikohiyan din iddos mgo tinodduwan din to,

“Nosorollan dow no oruwa robbon allow pomon ko-ungkay, od inguma ron kos pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan. Woy siyak no Anak to Minuvu, id boggoy riyot bollad to mgo minuvu amoy id pakpak diyon to krus.”
Na, id lolivuung iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio riyot baoy ni Caifas no mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis.
Id pomuhawang sikandan to kod-ammot ki Disas no waa od pokosaddoo, oyyos od po-imotayan dan sikandin.
Kahi ran to, “Konna ta id posasang to pista kos kod-ammot kandin, su saddook od ko-ukag kos mgo minuvu.”
Id Doddasan si Disas to Pomammut
To riyon don onsi Disas to Betania, mid undiyon sikandan to baoy ni Simon no duwon bohok no et-et no no-uliyan don.

Na, duwon sokkad no ba-ay nid inguma no id piyod to oray'n mahaa no pomammut no nokota-aw riyot tootawwan no binovallan pomot batu nod ngoranan to alabastro. Laggun tid ka-an onsi Disas, id porani kandin iddon ba-ay woy id daddas din iddos pomammut diyot uu ni Disas.
To nokita idda to mgo tinodduwan din, id langot sikandan woy kahi ran to, “Kuu! Mambo moho tid uuwakkan din ika?
Su otik id boligya pa nanoy ikon pomammut, maanmaan kos kontidad
woy dos bayad, id boggoy riyot mgo worowora.”
Piru nokosaddoo si Disas taddot osengan dan woy mid ikahi sikandin to, “Mambot od sowayon dow sikandin? Su moppiya man kos id puungan din koddi.
Oyya su iddos mgo worowora, inaayun dow od koruma. Piru siyak, konna a nikiyu inaayun od koruma.
Inis koddaddas din to pomammut ka-ay't lawa ku, id panoy rin atag to kodlobbong koddi.
Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no ahad ingkon ka-ay to ampow't ingod id ponudtuu iddos Moppiyon Dinoggan, id ponudtuu en mandad inis id puungan din koddi amoy'd kosompottan sikandin.”
Dos Puhawang to Kodboligya ki Disas
Sokkad taddot sopuu-oruwon apostoles no id ngoranan ki Judas Iscariote, id undiyon to mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis.
Woy mid ikahi sikandin to, “Pila kos id boggoy row koddi otik id boggoy ku riyot koniyun bollad si Disas?” Na, id iyap dan to otollumpuun plata no soopi woy id boggoy ran idda riyot kandin.
Pomon taddon timpu, id nangkap si Judas to po-ukit to kodboligya ki Disas.
Id Ka-an si Disas to Kotompusan no Kodlavung Duma to mgo Tinodduwan Din
Na riyot unnon allow to pista to Paan no Waa Potuvu,
id porani ki Disas iddos mgo tinudduwan din woy mid intud kandin. Kahi ran to, “Longaggon, ingkon koy od panoy to lavung ta atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan?”

Kahin Disas to, “Undiyonni row iddos sokkad no minuvu no riyot bonuwa to Jerusalem, woy osengi row sikandin no, ‘Mid ikahi iddos Tohodnonaw no id inguma ron kos timpu nid panoy to Monama atag kandin. Sikami no mgo tinodduwan din, id po-undini rin to baoy ru amoy ka-ay koy od lavung atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.’
Na, id puungan taddot mgo tinodduwan iddos id pomandu ni Disas woy id panoy ran to lavung atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.
To od kosagkup don, mid ka-an si Disas duma taddot sopuu-oruwon apostoles.
Laggun tid ka-an sikandan, mid ikahi si Disas to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no sokkad koniyu, od boligya koddi.”
Na oray'n naanu iddos mgo tinodduwan, woy ipat sokkad kandan, mid intud kandin, kahi ran to, “Longaggon, siyak bo kos od tommanon du?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Iddos id aggom to paan ka-ay't yohung duma koddi, sikandin en kos od boligya koddi.

Siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od patoy a en iling taddot no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama. Piru moka-arat-arat kod kotomanan taddot minuvu nod boligya koddi. Moppiya pa nanoy ko waa sikandin nominuvu.”
Na si Judas nod boligya ki Disas, mid ikahi to, “Tohodnonaw, siyak bo kos od tommanon du?” Id tavak si Disas to, “No-oseng dud en.”

Laggun tid ka-an sikandan, mid angoy si Disas to paan woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id toppiktoppik din idda woy id toyyow riyot mgo tinodduwan din, woy kahi rin to, “Owata row ini woy kanna row. Ini en kos lawa ku no id buwis atag koniyu.”
Na, mid angoy sikandin to kupa woy id posolamat diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id toyyow rin idda riyot kandan, woy kahi rin to, “Owata row ini woy inom kow langun.
Ini en kos longossa ku no id posivonnaa to kodpotonduwoy to Monama. Id tihis kos longossa ku atag to mo-uraan minuvu amoy'd koposinsyan kos mgo saa ran.
Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no dii ad od uman nod inom to ammis to ubas taman tod inguma ron iddos timpu no od inom a to lammin ammis duma koniyu init timpu nod hari ron kos Monamon Amoy ku.”
Na id kanta ran atag to koddoong to Monama, woy nopongnga, mid undiyon dan to Buvungan to mgo Olibo.
Id Ponudtuu Tapoy ni Disas iddos Kod-elle ni Pedro Kandin
Na kahin Disas kandan to, “Ini en no bulli, langun dow od paahuy woy'd tanan koddi, oyya su no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no,

content.text: ‘Od imotayan ku iddos tohodtamong to karnero woy od pokodsuwoysuwoy kos mgo karnero.’

content: Piru riyot timpu nod kovadnow ad, od unna a koniyu riyon to Galilea.”
Na kahin Pedro ki Disas to, “Ahad od tanan dan langun kikow, konna a en od tanan kikow.”
Kahin Disas to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku kikow, Pedro, no to dii pa od ukkaa kos manuk to ini en no bulli, ko-otollu rud kangkan tod elle no waa ka id kilaa koddi.”
Piru mid tavak si Pedro to, “Ahad od patoy a duma kikow, konna ku en id elle no waa ku sikkow nokilaa.” Na, ungketen dad en mandad kos id ikahi taddot dumon mgo tinodduwan din.
Dos Koddasaa ni Disas diyot Getsemane
Na, id undiyon si Disas to lugaa nod ngoranan to Getsemane duma taddot mgo tinodduwan din, woy id ikohiyan din sikandin to, “Unsad kow pa ka-ay, laggun tod dasaa a riyot ko-unnan.”
Id poruma rin si Pedro woy dos oruwon anak ni Sebedeo. Id tigkanoy kos id geddam din no lampas no lanu, woy oray'n movoggat kos ginawa rin.
Kahi rin to, “Lampas kos lanu ku no imman tod patoy ad. Polintotuwos kow pa ka-ay woy yo kow'd tinuhon.”

Na id poriyu boyow sikandin diyot ko-unnan, woy rutun, id laangkob sikandin diyot livuta woy mid dasaa, kahi rin to, “Amoy ku, otid kopakoy, yo ad po-ukita tod ingumon koosayan. Piru konna inis id kopi-i ku kos od kotuman, ko konna, idda rad en so kikow'n id kopi-i.”

To id livod sikandin diyot otollun tinodduwan din, nokita rin sikandan no nokotinuhon. Kahi rin ki Pedro to, “Mambot id tinuhon kow moho? Konna kow vo od pokogaha no diid tinuhon ahad sokkad da no uras?
Yo kow'd tinuhon, woy dasaa kow amoy dii kow'd kopiyod diyot kodpuung to saa. Dos ginawa row, od kopiyan nanoy nod puung to motallong, piru iddos lawa row, moomet.”

Na iko-oruwon timpu, id undiyon mandon si Disas to ko-unnan amoy'd dasaa. Kahi rin to, “Amoy ku, otik ko-ilangan en nod poko-ukit a to od ingumon koosayan, muopa no iddos kikow'n id kopi-i kos od kotuman.”
Nopongnga, id livod mandon sikandin diyot mgo tinodduwan din woy nokita rin sikandan no nokotinuhon, su oraroy ron no movoggat kos mata ran.
Na, id tanan mandon si Disas kandan woy mid undiyon to ko-unnan amoy'd dasaa to iko-otollun timpu iling taddot unnon dosalon din.

Nopongnga idda, id livod mandon sikandin diyot mgo tinodduwan woy mid ikahi to, “Mambot id tinuhon kow poron woy'd oimolloy? Ontongngi row, id inguma ron kos uras no siyak no Anak to Minuvu, id boggoy riyot bollad to mgo mosaasaa.
Onnow kowd, su ini ron kos minuvu nod boligya koddi.”
Dos Kod-ammot ki Disas

Laggun tod ooseng pa si Disas, id inguma si Judas no sokkad taddot sopuu-oruwon tinodduwan din. Id duma kandin iddos oray'n mo-uraan minuvu no posidpiyod to mgo polihuma woy mgo badas. Iyon id suhu kandan, iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio.
Tapoy id posaddoo ni Judas kandan iddos kilaannan, kahi rin to, ‘Iddos minuvu no od pongumustan ku ukit to kod-arok, sikandin en iddos od nongkapon dow. Na omotta row sikandin!”
De-en to kod-inguma ni Judas, idda ron en, id porani sikandin ki Disas woy mid ikahi to, “Tohodnonaw, moppiyon bulli!” Woy id pongumusta sikandin ki Disas ukit to kod-arok.
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Suwod, lukutowd woy puungiyud iddos dontulon to kod-undini row.” Na, id ammot dan si Disas woy id ponoggasan dan tid somad.
Idda ron en, sokkad taddot id duma ki Disas, id tadnus to polihuma rin, woy id tibbas din iddos uripon taddot mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis, de-en no-utas kos divauy'n tolinga.
Piru mid ikahi si Disas kandin to, “Polivod du kos polihuma ru ruwot lipi, su iddos langun nod tadnus to polihuma, od patoy en ukit to polihuma.
Waa ka vo nokosaddoo, no otik id kopi-i ku, od poko-umow a riyot Amoy ku nod tavang koddi woy idda ron en, od popiyod sikandin to maanmaan
no ponolihan?
Piru otid buyu a to tavang, konna od kotuman iddos Nosulat no Kahit Monama no ini en kos ko-ilangan nod kotomanan.”

Na mid ikahi si Disas diyot mgo minuvu to, “Kriminal a vo su goli kow od piyod to mgo polihuma woy mgo badas to kod-ammot koddi? Allow-allow a man id unsad woy id nonaw riyot templo, piru waa a man nikiyu omotta.
Piru od kotomanan ini langun, su amoy od kotuman iddos no-ikahi to mgo propeta riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama.”
Na, id tanan kandin iddos langun no tinodduwan woy id paahuy.
Dos Kod-isau ni Disas diyot Hukumanan to mgo Judio

Na iddos id pon-ammot ki Disas, id piyod kandin diyot baoy to mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis no si Caifas. Diyon mandad id lolivuung iddos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises woy dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio.

Si Pedro, id tintinundug no moriyu boyow taman diyot lama to baoy taddot mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis. Id usok sikandin dutun woy mid ounsad duma to mgo tohodtamong taddon baoy amoy'd kokita ko ondan kos od kotomanan ni Disas.
Na, iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos langun no sakup to hukumanan to mgo Judio, id nangkap sikandan to unayan, ahad konna bonnaa amoy'd uuhon dan to saa si Disas woy'd po-imotayan.
Piru waa nokita ran, ahad mo-uraa kos id posivonnaa to uhus moka-atag kandin. Na riyot mori, duwon oruwon minuvu no id undiyon to isowwan taddot mgo ponguu.
Woy kahi ran to, “Id oseng inin minuvu to, ‘Od gobban ku kos templo woy od poohinaton ku mandon daom to otollun allow.’ ”
Na, id lohinat iddos mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis woy id inturan din si Disas, kahi rin to, “Waa vo id pokotavak du taddot id oseng dan moka-atag kikow?”

Piru id po-onong-onong da en si Disas. Na, id ooseng mandon iddos mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis, kahi rin to, “Pongulivot ka ukit to ngaran to ma-antoy'n Monama no od ponudtulan koy nikkow ko sikkow ve-en kos Mesiyas, dos Anak to Monama.”

Mid tavak si Disas to, “No-oseng dud en. Piru od ikohiyan ku sikiyu no init morin allow, od kokita row no siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od unsad diyon lomig to kowanan to Monamon Motuus, woy od undini a pomon diyot datas to langit nod dumannan to souhapun.”

Na, id bendas taddot mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis iddos umpak din pomon to lingasa rin, woy mid kahi sikandin to, “Id sosumpalit sikandin to Monama! Konnad ko-ilangan nod angoy ki pa to duma nod posivonnaa taddot saa rin? Sikiyu ron en kos nokorinog taddot kodsosumpalit din.
Na ondan kos od ko-oseng dow ka-ay?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Ollog en sikandin nod imotayan.”
Na, id ilobban dan sikandin diyot bonnong woy id ponsuntuk woy dos duma, id pontabpi kandin.
Kahi ran to, “Na sikkow no Mesiyas kun uvag, otukow ve-en ko ondoy kos id tabpi kikow?”
Dos Kod-elle ni Pedro ki Disas

Laggun tid ounsad si Pedro riyot lama, duwon sokkad no ba-ay no sudsuhuwon to mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis no id porani kandin woy mid ikahi to, “Sikkow mandad, sokkad ka en no duma ni Disas no toho Galilea.”
Piru mid elle si Pedro riyot isowwan to langun, kahi rin to, “Te, waa moho saddoo ku ruwot id oseng du!”

Waa nouhoy pomon tadda, mid undiyon sikandin to sobbangan to lama. Na rutun, duwon mandon sokkad no ba-ay'n sudsuhuwon no nokokita kandin, woy id osengan din iddos mgo minuvu rutun. Kahi rin to, “Ikon minuvu, sokkad en sikandin nid duma ki Disas no toho Nazaret.”
Piru mid elle rad mandon si Pedro no golid pongulivot, kahi rin to, “Waa a moho nokokilaa ruwon no minuvu!”
Todtahad, id porani ki Pedro iddos mgo minuvu nid loohinat dutun woy kahi ran to, “Bonnaa en no sokkad ka en kandan, su riyot kodlituk du, iling mandad taddot kodlituk to mgo toho Galilea.”
Piru id pongulivot pe-en sikandin, kahi rin to, “Ahad od patoy a pa ko-ungkay ko id ouhus a, su nosorollan to Monama no waa ku en moho nokilaa ikon minuvu.” Na idda ron en, id ukkaa iddos manuk.

Woy nosompottan ni Pedro iddos id ikahi ni Disas kandin no, “To dii pa od ukkaa kos manuk to ini en no bulli, ko-otollu rud kangkan tod elle no waa ka id kilaa koddi.” Na, mid awa sikandin woy oray'n mopet kos sinoggawon din.

Dos unnon lavung ka-ay'n pista, od ngoranan no pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan. Od sompotton to mgo Judio iddos kodleggua to kovuyyahan dan pomon diyot Ehipto ukit to kodka-an dan to karni to natin karnero woy taddot paan no waa potuvu.

Od kovasa ini riyot Salmo 110:1; Daniel 7:13.
